description: Sports Kit motion atoms for landscape 16:9: comparison duel, stat leader, player poster, goal, fixture and score cards on the Nova hook foundation.
primary_publishing_shape: Long-form Vietnamese soccer analysis; platform publishing and platform-specific adaptations are not configured in this package.
renderer_requirement: Use large expressive Vietnamese hooks, condensed numeric display type, tactile but purposeful pitch marks, layered color and restrained kinetic motion. Open on a hook card: 5-8 word claim in condensed display type with a lime rule, punched in at frame 0. Select tactical, statline, source, and chart plates by story beat; a statline with one hero metric renders as a single 3x numeral with pop. Omit subtitles and use only reviewed evidence. Keep statline, chart, and source graphics on their own compositions: head-to-head split scoreboard; labeled zero-baseline chart; archival pull-quote source note. Chart type follows data meaning: bars/columns for category comparisons, line for ordered time series, pie/donut only for a verified part-to-whole with at most four parts. Scenes slide in from the right over 0.3s; hero and statline numerals count up from zero across the beat; hook card lines reveal staggered. Count-up animates reviewed values only, never invented ones. Manim pre-renders six motion atoms (HookCard, ComparisonDuel, StatLeader, PlayerPoster, GoalCard, FixtureCard, ScoreCard) with slide-in 0.3s, count-up 6 steps and stagger 0.18s; PIL plates keep locked Barlow/BeVietnam finish. Kit red is an opt-in colorway; defaults stay ink.
change_policy: No per-content edits to locked design. Changes require a new package version and explicit owner review.
